english.note: Use this as a conversational confirmation meaning “indeed” or “so it has.”

examples.english: Oh, so it is; if you hadn’t said so, I wouldn’t have remembered today is Saturday.
examples.traditional: 係喎，你唔講我都唔記得今日係星期六。
